title: feat(plugin-aggrid): Add enterprise data grid features
body:
## Continue Development of object-aggrid Plugin

### Development Plan

- [x] **Phase 1: Export Functionality**
  - [x] Add CSV export feature
  - [x] Add onExport event callback
  - [x] Update schema types for export options

- [x] **Phase 2: Cell & Row Editing**
  - [x] Add cell editing support
  - [x] Add row editing mode (inline)
  - [x] Add onCellValueChanged callback

- [x] **Phase 3: Event Callbacks System**
  - [x] Add onSelectionChanged callback
  - [x] Add onRowClicked callback
  - [x] Add onCellClicked callback
  - [x] Add onContextMenuAction callback
  - [x] Update types for all callbacks

- [x] **Phase 4: Status Bar & Aggregations**
  - [x] Add status bar component
  - [x] Add aggregation functions (sum, avg, count, min, max)
  - [x] Make status bar configurable

- [x] **Phase 5: Context Menu**
  - [x] Add context menu support
  - [x] Add default row actions
  - [x] Make context menu items configurable
  - [x] Remove icon support to prevent HTML injection

- [x] **Phase 6: Column Features**
  - [x] Add column configuration support
  - [x] Add column resizing support
  - [x] Add range selection support

- [x] **Phase 7: Documentation & Tests**
  - [x] Add examples for new features
  - [x] Update README with new capabilities
  - [x] Update TypeScript types
  - [x] Verify all tests pass
  - [x] Add interactive examples in docs
  - [x] Document AG Grid Community vs Enterprise

- [x] **Final: Build and Validate**
  - [x] Build the plugin
  - [x] Run tests
  - [x] Verify all features work
  - [x] Address code review feedback
  - [x] Add documentation examples
  - [x] Fix all lint and test issues
  - [x] Address PR review comments

### Summary

The object-aggrid plugin has been successfully enhanced with enterprise-grade features and comprehensive documentation. All PR review feedback has been addressed.

**Test Results**: ✅ 8 passed (8)
**Lint Status**: ✅ 0 errors, 18 warnings (acceptable)
**Build Status**: ✅ Successful

**Key Improvements from PR Review:**
- Added proper API guard for export functionality
- Dedicated callback for context menu actions
- Removed HTML injection risk from custom menu items
- Clarified CSV-only export support
- Added comprehensive AG Grid Community vs Enterprise documentation
- Proper TypeScript typing throughout
- Enhanced test coverage for new features
